journey.title: Moving data
journey.purpose: Export a complete backup or a recipe collection, review an import fully before any write, and restore with a recoverable checkpoint and a default that adds meals only.

steps.intent: Choose a complete backup, a recipe collection, or a printable export with distinct names.
Inspect schema version, counts, duplicates, unsupported fields, and unresolved references before any live write.
See the precise restore impact and that a recoverable checkpoint exists.
Confirm a full restore or take the default of adding meals only.

claims.statement: Parsing and previewing an import never mutates live data, and a failed apply leaves the previous workspace intact.
A restore replaces workspace content but cannot import identity, credentials, subscription, or another tenant's authority.
